title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode16 A Helping Hand

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something wrong with that? Hey, it's not often I see you hanging around by yourself. What happened? Your friend finally decide he's had enough of you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Turns out we never really did understand each other...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe they really did have a fight. Do you think they're all right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're probably right.
But it's nothing you should be worrying about, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I managed to get the CD I ordered.
An should be here soon, so I'll just—oh!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, hey Azusawa. Been a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just... I haven't seen you at any events lately, and you haven't been coming to Weekend Garage. Is everything all right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We happened to sing at the same event as Shinonome last night, but he looked lost in thought the whole time. An even mentioned that his performance seemed off...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Did you two get into a fight?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't exactly call it a fight, but that's me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, this is something I should have done a lot sooner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's okay. I just got here a few minutes ago.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hey, An. I just saw Aoyagi.
He seemed a little down as well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Does that mean they actually had a falling out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But why are you so worried about those two after everything they did to us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, we see them a lot at Weekend Garage, and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know a lot's happened, but they did eventually acknowledge us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That may be true, but still...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Sorry, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! You're the one who helped Akito and Toya mess with the sound during our performance at RED!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: I-I wanted to apologize and...to let you know that Akito and Toya weren't involved that night...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you saying those two didn't ask you to do that?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: They both planned on going up against you in a fair fight. Cutting the power...was my idea. They didn't know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sigh... Why would you do that?
You totally ruined the event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So why tell us now when you could have just kept quiet?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: I thought everyone was just making a fuss about you because of who your dad is. But after seeing your performance, I realized I was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Your singing was amazing.
It made me want to work harder to get crowds as pumped with my music as you do.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: So, um... I'm really sorry for messing up your performance!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm... Apology accepted.
Just promise you won't do anything like that ever again!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So... Those two had nothing to do with it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm all finished for the day.

rows.Speaker: Library Monitor
rows.Line: Oh, thanks. Everything always goes more smoothly when you're around. I never thought there'd be so much work to do on the library committee.

rows.Speaker: Library Monitor
rows.Line: Hey, I haven't seen Akito around for a while. I'm used to him always stopping by when you're on duty to bug us about when you'll be finished. Hm?

rows.Speaker: Library Monitor
rows.Line: Looks like you have a different visitor today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya, can I borrow you for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said she wanted to talk to you, so I asked her to wait here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, are you sure it's okay for me to be here?
I'm not a student here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's fine as long as you don't get caught. There are always students coming here for sports matches and stuff, so even if we do get caught, we can just talk our way out of it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, aren't you a hall monitor?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Unlike Tenma or Kamishiro, Kohane isn't about to break any of the school rules here. It's fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Go on, Kohane. You came here for a reason, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Aoyagi, are you going to sing with Shinonome anymore?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know we only just recently met, so I know this isn't really any of my business, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Why are you so worried about us?
After what we did...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, but that wasn't you, now was it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The one who actually did it explained everything.
He said you two had planned to battle us fair and square.
